title: appmeta output
description: Metadata extracted from an Android .apk or iOS .ipa. String fields are empty when the binary does not declare them.

bundleId.description: Android package name or iOS CFBundleIdentifier.

name.description: User-visible app name: the default-locale android:label, or CFBundleDisplayName / CFBundleName.

minOsVersion.description: Minimum OS release, e.g. "8.0" (Android API 26 mapped to its release) or "15.0" (MinimumOSVersion). Unknown future Android API levels are reported as "API <n>".

targetOsVersion.description: Android targetSdkVersion mapped to a release, or the iOS SDK the app was built with (DTPlatformVersion).

isSimulator.description: True for iOS builds that run only on the simulator. Always false for Android.

isDebuggable.description: android:debuggable, or get-task-allow in the iOS provisioning profile.

architectures.description: Android ABIs from lib/ (empty for pure-Java apps), or Mach-O architectures of the iOS executable.

permissions.description: Android uses-permission names. Always empty for iOS.

signing.description: iOS provisioning profile summary; null for Android and for unsigned or simulator builds.

icon.description: App icon re-encoded as PNG, at most 512x512. Null when no raster icon could be extracted; a warning says why.

base64.description: The PNG bytes. Omitted when the caller asked for no icon data.

warnings.description: Human-readable notes about data that could not be extracted.
